messages:
marta-release: Post-deploy smoke failing in eu-west after today's rollout. Monitoring shows synthetic probe 'chat-gen-latency-eu' timing out with intermittent 504s. Deploy was v2.3.1 — can we get a quick triage? :eyes:
deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: release v2.3.1 -> prod. Canary ramped to 5% at 1763600001, health checks passed, scheduled ramp to 100%.
monitoring-bot: ALERT (synthetic): probe=chat-gen-latency-eu threshold=1% 5xx rate. Observed 5xx rate=12% over 3m, avg latency=1.4s. Dashboard: https://monitoring.redwood/probes/chat-gen-latency-eu
sam-oncall: Yep, seeing the 504 bursts in the request logs. Sample trace: trace_id=abc12345 -> backend returned 504 via nginx. Correlates w/ higher KV cache miss rate.
alisa-platform: Can we hold the rollout and pin eu-west to the previous stable variant? Suggest reverting routing to v2.3.0-stable while we debug.
marta-release: Hold ramp. Don't ramp to 100%. Sam, can you run the smoke script against eu-west and paste output?
sam-oncall: Running: `./tools/smoketest.sh --region eu-west --probe chat-gen --count 50`
sam-oncall: smoke results: 50 requests -> 44 OK, 6 504. Error traces show `kv_cache_miss -> fallback slow path` and increased kernel fallback latencies.
dan-engineer: I see one related commit in PR #7452 that adjusts kernel selection heuristics. On long sequences (>1024) it forces a slower path that might amplify cache misses.
alisa-platform: If PR #7452 is the likely culprit, pinning to q8_128 variant should avoid the new fallback. We can apply a routing rule: eu-west -> model_variant=v2.3.0-stable.
marta-release: I'm creating a quick change: emergency pin for eu-west and an incident note. If error rate doesn't fall below 3% in 30m we'll rollback fully. Also scheduling a rollback window at 13:30 UTC if needed.
sam-oncall: Patch applied locally to router for pinning, running another smoke run. Increasing probe frequency to 30s for the eu probes.
monitoring-bot: CONFIG UPDATE: synthetic probe 'chat-gen-latency-eu' frequency set to 30s per request; verbose logging enabled.
deploy-bot: Routing change applied: eu-west pinned to v2.3.0-stable (change id: rc-20260320-1). Canary remains at 5% elsewhere.
marta-release: Post-change smoke: 50 requests -> 49 OK, 1 504. 5xx rate down to ~2%. Good improvement, keep monitoring for 30m before marking resolved.
alisa-platform: Nice. Once stable <1% for 30m we can re-evaluate PR #7452 revert vs targeted kernel fix. Recommend keeping version pin until fix is validated.
sam-oncall: Setting alert: trigger if 5xx rate >3% sustained over 5m. I'll also dump KV cache hit metrics to the incident doc.
marta-release: Filing release note update and incident blurb: https://confluence.redwood/releases/v2.3.1#incident-20260320. Will include rollback criteria and timeline.
monitoring-bot: NOTE: probe error rate currently 2% (5m window). Next status update at 1763601800.
marta-release: Thanks all. Leaving thread open for the 30m watch. If anything spikes, @sam-oncall please start rollback procedure.
